# GammaRed <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GammaRed:Float32 red:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `red` | In | Int32 | required | The input value, 0 to 255. |

**Returns:** The output value for the input.

## Description

The output value of the red gamma table for an input value, as set by [SetGamma](SetGamma). By default every value gives itself.

## Differences

* The tables change what the window shows and never the gamma of the display, see [SetGamma](SetGamma).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetGamma 100, 100, 100, 200, 200, 200
UpdateGamma
Print GammaRed(100) + " " + GammaGreen(100) + " " + GammaBlue(100)
Print GammaRed(101)
WaitKey
```
